def integer_promote_impl(a_ty: tl.dtype, b_ty: tl.dtype) -> tl.dtype:
    a_rank = a_ty.int_bitwidth
    b_rank = b_ty.int_bitwidth
    a_sn = a_ty.int_signedness
    b_sn = b_ty.int_signedness
    # Rules for signedness taken from "Usual arithmetic conversions" on
    # https://en.cppreference.com/w/c/language/conversion.
    if a_sn == b_sn:
        return a_ty if a_rank > b_rank else b_ty
    elif a_sn == tl.dtype.SIGNEDNESS.UNSIGNED:
        return a_ty if a_rank >= b_rank else b_ty
    elif b_sn == tl.dtype.SIGNEDNESS.UNSIGNED:
        return b_ty if b_rank >= a_rank else a_ty
    raise TypeError(f"unexpected signedness {a_sn} and {b_sn}")

def binary_op_type_checking_impl(lhs: tl.tensor | numbers.Number, rhs: tl.tensor | numbers.Number, builder: ir.builder,
                                 allow_lhs_ptr=False, allow_rhs_ptr=False, arithmetic_check=True,
                                 div_or_mod=False) -> Tuple[tl.tensor, tl.tensor]:
    lhs_is_scalar = isinstance(lhs, numbers.Number)
    rhs_is_scalar = isinstance(rhs, numbers.Number)
    if lhs_is_scalar:
        lhs_scalar = lhs
        lhs = to_tensor(lhs, builder)
    if rhs_is_scalar:
        rhs_scalar = rhs
        rhs = to_tensor(rhs, builder)

    # implicit typecasting
    lhs_sca_ty = lhs.type.scalar
    rhs_sca_ty = rhs.type.scalar
    check_ptr_type_impl(lhs_sca_ty, rhs_sca_ty, allow_lhs_ptr)
    check_ptr_type_impl(rhs_sca_ty, lhs_sca_ty, allow_rhs_ptr)
    if arithmetic_check and not lhs_sca_ty.is_ptr() and not rhs_sca_ty.is_ptr():
        ret_sca_ty = computation_type_impl(lhs_sca_ty, lhs_is_scalar, rhs_sca_ty, rhs_is_scalar, div_or_mod)
        if (lhs_is_scalar and lhs_scalar < 0 and ret_sca_ty.is_int_unsigned()
                or rhs_is_scalar and rhs_scalar < 0 and ret_sca_ty.is_int_unsigned()):
            raise ValueError("Cannot perform a binary operation between an unsigned tensor and a negative scalar. "
                             "Perform a explicit cast on one of them.")
        lhs = full(
            (), lhs_scalar, dtype=ret_sca_ty, builder=builder) if lhs_is_scalar else cast(lhs, ret_sca_ty, builder)
        rhs = full(
            (), rhs_scalar, dtype=ret_sca_ty, builder=builder) if rhs_is_scalar else cast(rhs, ret_sca_ty, builder)

    # implicit broadcasting
    lhs, rhs = broadcast_impl_value(lhs, rhs, builder)
    return lhs, rhs

def binary_op_sanitize_overflow_impl(lhs: tl.tensor, rhs: tl.tensor, builder: ir.builder, binary_op: callable):
    if lhs.type.scalar.int_bitwidth >= 64 or not builder.options.sanitize_overflow:
        return
    lhs_sca_ty = lhs.type.scalar
    rhs_sca_ty = rhs.type.scalar
    assert lhs_sca_ty == rhs_sca_ty
    assert lhs_sca_ty.is_int()
    lhs = cast(lhs, tl.int64, builder)
    rhs = cast(rhs, tl.int64, builder)
    ret = binary_op(lhs, rhs, False, builder)
    max_value = lhs_sca_ty.get_int_max_value()
    max_value = tl.tensor(builder.get_int64(max_value), tl.int64)
    min_value = lhs_sca_ty.get_int_min_value()
    min_value = tl.tensor(builder.get_int64(min_value), tl.int64)
    cond = and_(less_equal(ret, max_value, builder), greater_equal(ret, min_value, builder), builder)
    msg = f"int{lhs_sca_ty.int_bitwidth} overflow detected for operation {binary_op.__name__}"
    device_assert(cond, msg, builder)
elide: 注意 binary_op(lhs, rhs, False, builder) 里第 3 参 False 关掉 sanitize——int64 复算自身不再递归查溢出,否则死循环

def broadcast_impl_value(lhs: tl.tensor, rhs: tl.tensor, builder: ir.builder) -> tl.tensor:
    lhs_ty = lhs.type
    rhs_ty = rhs.type

    # make_shape_compatible(block, scalar)
    if lhs_ty.is_block() and not rhs_ty.is_block():
        rhs_ty = tl.block_type(rhs_ty.scalar, lhs_ty.shape)
        rhs = tl.tensor(builder.create_splat(rhs.handle, lhs_ty.get_block_shapes()), rhs_ty)
    # make_shape_compatible(scalar, block)
    elif not lhs_ty.is_block() and rhs_ty.is_block():
        lhs_ty = tl.block_type(lhs_ty.scalar, rhs_ty.shape)
        lhs = tl.tensor(builder.create_splat(lhs.handle, rhs_ty.get_block_shapes()), lhs_ty)
    # make_shape_compatible(block, block)
    elif lhs_ty.is_block() and rhs_ty.is_block():
        lhs_shape = lhs_ty.get_block_shapes()
        rhs_shape = rhs_ty.get_block_shapes()

        if len(lhs_shape) < len(rhs_shape):
            # Add new axes to lhs
            for _ in range(len(lhs_shape), len(rhs_shape)):
                lhs = tl.tensor(builder.create_expand_dims(lhs.handle, 0),
                                tl.block_type(lhs_ty.scalar, [1] + lhs_shape))
                lhs_ty = lhs.type
                lhs_shape = lhs_ty.get_block_shapes()
        elif len(rhs_shape) < len(lhs_shape):
            # Add new axes to rhs
            for _ in range(len(rhs_shape), len(lhs_shape)):
                rhs = tl.tensor(builder.create_expand_dims(rhs.handle, 0),
                                tl.block_type(rhs_ty.scalar, [1] + rhs_shape))
                rhs_ty = rhs.type
                rhs_shape = rhs_ty.get_block_shapes()
        assert len(rhs_shape) == len(lhs_shape)

        ret_shape = []
        for i, left in enumerate(lhs_shape):
            right = rhs_shape[i]
            if left == 1:
                ret_shape.append(right)
            elif (right == 1) or (right == left):
                ret_shape.append(left)
            else:
                raise ValueError("Cannot make_shape_compatible: incompatible dimensions "
                                 "at index " + str(i) + ": " + str(left) + " and " + str(right))
        if lhs_shape != ret_shape:
            ret_ty = tl.block_type(lhs_ty.scalar, ret_shape)
            lhs = tl.tensor(builder.create_broadcast(lhs.handle, ret_shape), ret_ty)
        if rhs_shape != ret_shape:
            ret_ty = tl.block_type(rhs_ty.scalar, ret_shape)
            rhs = tl.tensor(builder.create_broadcast(rhs.handle, ret_shape), ret_ty)
    # (scalar, scalar) => returns original blocks
    return lhs, rhs
elide: 两个 0 维 scalar 相遇(末尾注释)直接原样返回,不进任何分支

design_decisions.decision: 标量按 kind『不拔高张量档次』(step 0,PyTorch 式)
design_decisions.why: fp16 张量 + 一个 Python 浮点常量,若把常量当普通 fp32 操作数会把整块升成 fp32(多一次 upcast、多占带宽)。step 0 判定『标量 kind ≤ 张量 kind』时直接返回 tensor_ty(fp16),常量随后用 full 按 fp16 重建——结果保持 fp16。这正是本章读者收益:看懂后主动写显式 dtype 的标量就不会踩隐式 upcast。反例:若把常量物化成真的 fp32 张量(is_scalar=False),step 0 不触发,step 2 把整块拉成 fp32

design_decisions.decision: fp16/bf16 遇 / 或 % 一律升 fp32
design_decisions.why: PTX 没有原生 fp16/bf16 的除法/取模;div_or_mod 时 step 0/3/4 都返回 fp32 绕开(源码注释列了 fp16 原生支持的 op:add/sub/mul/fma/neg/abs/min/max/tanh/ex2/setp)

design_decisions.decision: bf16 只在两侧都是 bf16 时才返回 bf16,否则 fp32
design_decisions.why: bf16 与其它非标准浮点混用时精度语义不清,保守升 fp32;而 fp16 只要一侧是 fp16 就返回 fp16(step 3 与 step 4 不对称)

design_decisions.decision: 两个不同 fp8 变体相遇返回 fp16
design_decisions.why: fp8 变体(e4nv/e5/e4b8…)指数位/偏置各异,无共同 fp8;同变体保留自身,异变体统一升 fp16 再算

design_decisions.decision: 整数走 C 的 usual arithmetic conversions
design_decisions.why: 同号取更宽;异号时无符号侧 rank≥有符号侧则取无符号,否则取有符号——直接对齐 C/PyTorch 传统,避免 triton 自造一套整数规则

design_decisions.decision: 标量统一用 full 重建而非 cast
design_decisions.why: binary_op_type_checking_impl 里标量走 full((),原值,dtype=ret),张量才走 cast——标量重建避开『先按值域裹成 int32 再 cast 到 ret』的中间一跳,直接落到 ret 类型的常量

design_decisions.decision: 广播的『非 1 且不等就报错』
design_decisions.why: NumPy/PyTorch 广播语义:尺寸 1 的维可扩到任意、缺的前导维补 1,但两侧都非 1 又不相等则形状不兼容立即报错——保证输出 shape 唯一确定

design_decisions.decision: 溢出检查升 int64 复算且关掉自身 sanitize
design_decisions.why: int(<64)加减乘可能溢出,升到 int64 头顶空间足够复算真值,再与原类型 max/min 比对;复算调 binary_op(...,False,...) 第 3 参关掉 sanitize,否则 int64 加法又触发自己→死循环。int64 本身 int_bitwidth>=64 时函数开头直接 return(无更宽类型可复算)

theory.topic: computation_type_impl 是可枚举的类型代数
theory.detail: 输入域:(a_dtype, a_is_scalar, b_dtype, b_is_scalar, div_or_mod);dtype 取值有限(int/uint 各档、fp8×5 变体、fp16/bf16/fp32/fp64)。规则是六档 if 瀑布,先短路先赢,故结果是两侧 dtype 的确定性函数。explainer 可直接调真函数喂『dtype 对 × is_scalar × div_or_mod』的笛卡尔积成表,与 PyTorch type promotion 逐格比对验证。

step 0 的核心是 scalar_ty.kind().value <= tensor_ty.kind().value——只有当标量的 kind 不高于张量时才让标量不参与提升。即 int 标量 + fp16 张量→fp16(int kind 1 ≤ fp kind 2,标量退让);但 fp 标量 + int 张量→标量 kind 2 > 张量 kind 1,step 0 不触发,落到后面档位(fp 一侧存在→按 fp 升)。
block-scalar:标量 splat 到 block 的 shape,O(1) 语义复制填满,无补维。block-block:先把秩小的一侧从前导补 1(create_expand_dims,右对齐),补齐到等秩后逐维取 max(1→对方、相等→自身、否则报错),两侧各自 create_broadcast 到 ret_shape。输出 shape 唯一。

theory.topic: 溢出检查的复算不变量
theory.detail: 对 int_bitwidth=b(<64)的加/减/乘,真值范围可能超出 [min_b, max_b];升到 int64(空间足够容纳 b-bit 二元运算真值,因 2*63>63)复算得 ret,断言 min_b ≤ ret ≤ max_b。回指 ch01 已见的 add(sanitize_overflow=True),这里揭示它在 semantic 层怎么被 binary_op_sanitize_overflow_impl 触发。

mechanisms.name: computation_type_impl 六档分层类型提升规则
mechanisms.note: 本章核心。六档 if 瀑布:0)标量按 kind 不拔高张量→1)fp64→2)fp32→3)fp16(除模除外)→4)bf16(两侧皆 bf16 才 bf16 否则 fp32)→5)异 fp8→fp16→6)整数提升。needs_figure:六档瀑布决策图。worked_example:fp16×fp32→fp32、fp16×标量→fp16、bf16×fp8→fp32、int32×int64→int64。规则出处对齐 PyTorch/C usual arithmetic conversions(源码注释)

mechanisms.name: 标量按 kind 不拔高张量档次(PyTorch 式 step 0)
mechanisms.note: 读者收益主线的落点:fp16 张量 + Python 浮点常量→仍是 fp16(不被悄悄升 fp32),因标量 kind ≤ 张量 kind 时直接返回 tensor_ty。worked_example 对照:标量常量 vs 物化成真 fp32 张量两种写法的产出 dtype 差异——教读者主动写显式 dtype 的标量省一次转换。div_or_mod 且张量是 fp16/bf16 时例外升 fp32

mechanisms.name: integer_promote_impl 整数 usual arithmetic conversions
mechanisms.note: 第 6 档。同号取更宽 rank;异号时无符号侧 rank≥有符号侧则取无符号否则取有符号。worked_example:int32×int64→int64、uint32×int32→(rank 相等,取无符号)uint32、int8×uint8→uint8。div_or_mod 且异号直接报错

mechanisms.name: binary_op_type_checking_impl 一次 x+y 的总调度流水
mechanisms.note: 串起 to_tensor(裹标量)→check_ptr(指针合法性)→computation_type_impl(算 ret 类型)→full/cast(统一到 ret)→broadcast_impl_value(对齐形状)。needs_figure:五步流水管道图,标出标量走 full、张量走 cast 的分叉。回收 ch05 f7『tensor dunder 只转发不决策』的答案就在这层

mechanisms.name: to_tensor 标量裹成 0 维 tensor 并按值域定 dtype
mechanisms.note: bool→int1;int 按值域 int32/uint32/int64/uint64;float 按 fp32 值域 float32 否则 float64。worked_example:5→int32、2**40→int64、3.14→float32、1e300→float64。决定了 step 0 里标量的初始 dtype 与 is_scalar 标志

mechanisms.name: check_ptr_type_impl 指针算术合法性护栏
mechanisms.note: 总调度里的一环:ptr+异类 ptr、ptr+float 抛 IncompatibleTypeErrorImpl。仅当该侧不允许 ptr 或类型不兼容才拦,加法允许 ptr+offset 故 allow 传 True

mechanisms.name: broadcast_impl_value 广播两支(block-scalar splat / block-block 补维)
mechanisms.note: block-scalar:标量 create_splat 复制填满 block shape。block-block:秩小侧从前导补 1(create_expand_dims 右对齐)→逐维取兼容尺寸(1→对方、相等→自身、否则报错)→各自 create_broadcast。needs_figure:两支对比图(splat 填满 vs 补维扩展)。worked_example:(128,)×() 标量→splat;(128,1)×(1,64)→(128,64);(128,)×(64,128)→补维成(1,128)再扩(64,128)

mechanisms.name: broadcast_impl_shape 单侧广播到目标 shape 的底座
mechanisms.note: 非 block 直接 splat;block 逐维校验『shape[i]≠item 且 item≠1 就报错(非单例维不可改)』,否则 create_broadcast。worked_example:(1,64)→(128,64) 合法;(3,64)→(128,64) 报错(非单例维 3≠128)。是 broadcast_impl_value 最终落地的 IR 层判据

mechanisms.name: binary_op_sanitize_overflow_impl 整数溢出 int64 复算比对
mechanisms.note: 回指 ch01 的 add(sanitize_overflow=True)。int(<64)且 builder.options.sanitize_overflow 开:升 int64 复算(第 3 参 False 防死循环)→和该类型 get_int_max/min_value 比对→device_assert。int64 或未开则开头 return。worked_example:int8 的 100+100=200>127 触发断言;int32 常规值通过

recover.text: cast 是可数的真 IR op、tensor 约四十个 dunder 全是薄壳转发进 semantic 层——本章立『tensor 只转发不决策』,把 x+y 两个 dtype 怎么对齐/结果什么类型(computation_type_impl 的类型提升与隐式广播)交给下一章 ch06 揭开;『避免无谓 cast』这条性能建议在后续访存/降级章逐一兑现。
recover.how_recovered: 本章 add(L218)正是 ch05 tensor.__add__ 转发的落点:决策全在 semantic 层——computation_type_impl 定 dtype、broadcast_impl_value 对齐形状。『避免无谓 cast』这条在 step 0『标量不拔高张量档次』上首次兑现现金:看懂 fp16+标量常量仍是 fp16、主动写显式 dtype 就省下隐式 upcast(后续访存/降级章继续兑现)。
